title: [Master] - Chance of success % does not validate correctly when using the action type "Update" in Opportunity
summary: Chance of Success % on an opportunity entry now validates correctly when the Update action type is used. The fix is in the Opportunity Entry table, and tests were added.
key_points: Fixed Chance of Success % validation in the Opportunity Entry table
Fixes the case where the Update action type is used on an opportunity
Added test coverage in the marketing opportunity tests
